triggerReason: The human project owner repeatedly could not understand the technical dashboard and explicitly requested a dedicated, genuinely understandable page. Passing engineering checks had not made the explanation clear enough.
action: Make a separate Chinese-first, ordinary-language page at / and /human. Explain what the programme is, whether this study has stopped, one real attempt-counterexample-revision story, current practical limits and the difference between internal measurements and model costs. Keep /research as the technical workbench and /archive/city as the retained history. Add a pure read-only human facts projection with evidence binding and fail-closed missing/unknown states; do not change the research kernel, authorization, budget or completed study.
outcome: Implementation record, not a production deployment certificate. The page is designed around the reader's six ordinary questions instead of internal terminology, source hashes or many KPI cards. A concrete story is available only when the persisted source, proposal, counterexample and later evaluation records match; no static demonstration is passed off as live data. Finished-step limits are distinguished from monetary cost, and a successful data read is not claimed as a live thinking agent. Release readiness and the unchanged production ledger still require the actual local/CI/browser and post-deployment evidence; no future SHA or full test success is asserted here.
evidence: docs/HUMAN_READING.md defines the reader-first explanation, factual limits and progressive evidence disclosure.

The new human data projection and browser parser have dedicated synthetic-reference and corruption tests; successful pages are validated with actual read-only API responses rather than a mocked success.
The pre-change production snapshot records the already-ended study; this UI-only feature does not grant more work, restart a study, invoke models or increase budgets.
The existing city archive and original scientific evidence remain unchanged. Actual deployment identity must come from the exact release health and CI evidence, not this source manifest.
